1.title: Couple Accused of Killing Their Son-in-Law in Bay Area Park
1.summary: Jonathan McKinsey, an engineer who worked in the games department for The New York Times, was fatally shot Saturday in a San Francisco suburb. Police have accused his parents-in-law, both 76.

2.title: Embarrassing Breach at F.B.I. Fuels Fears of Harm to Its Employees
2.summary: In an internal memo, the F.B.I. said it believed the hackers may have stolen sensitive information on all of its employees.

3.title: Justice Alito Recuses Himself Days Before Major Climate-Change Case
3.summary: Justice Samuel A. Alito Jr. had faced pressure to recuse himself from the climate case because he owns stock in oil companies.

4.title: Possible Terrorist Plot at RAF Fairford Air Base in U.K.: What We Know
4.summary: Five British men who were detained near R.A.F. Fairford, a base used by American forces in the war against Iran, were being released on bail but remained under investigation.

5.title: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
5.summary: Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.

6.title: Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan
6.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.
